_comment: Source of truth for the in-app 'update available' sheet. Publish a byte-identical copy to https://saiyedrushan.github.io/hayya-site/version.json once a build is live on the store. Full instructions: CICD.md, 'Announcing a store update'.
notes: Hayya now tells you what changed, and Settings → About → What’s new keeps the earlier notes
Declining a call offers reasons to tap, and can have it call back in 20 to 60 minutes instead
The after-salah list ends on a card for your own duʿās — add, tick, and keep them on your phone only
Every list gets a Mark all as done at the bottom
Large system text fits again: prayer times, the date, the Sunrise row and Arabic titles no longer overflow
The keyboard no longer hides Decline while you type a reason
